info.title: NPN Demand Forecasting API
info.description:
Serves 28-day-ahead demand forecasts for 30,490 Walmart store-item series from a **frozen** LightGBM Tweedie blend (0.60 × direct + 0.40 × recursive; validation RMSE 2.0929 / MAE 1.0395 on 853,720 held-out predictions).

**Scientific honesty is part of the API contract.**

* Error bands are *empirical backtest error*, never model-produced prediction intervals — the model emits point forecasts only.
* Accuracy is always reported for the aggregation level being viewed, because the same forecast is ~28% accurate per store-item and ~97% chain-wide.
* No accuracy is claimed for the delivered forecast window: it has no ground truth.

See `/api/v1/meta/capabilities` for what is implemented, what the research phase rejected on evidence, and what is not supported.

question.title: Question
question.description: A natural-language question about the forecasts or model.
examples: Explain this forecast in plain language

store_id.title: Store Id
store_id.description: Selected store, e.g. CA_3. Supplies series context.

intent.title: Intent
intent.description: Which family of data was retrieved to answer.

grounded.title: Grounded
grounded.description: True when every figure in the answer traces to the supplied context.

ungrounded_numbers.title: Ungrounded Numbers
ungrounded_numbers.description: Figures with no source in the context. Should be empty.

injection_suspected.title: Injection Suspected
injection_suspected.description: True when the question matched a prompt-injection pattern.

context_keys.title: Context Keys
context_keys.description: Top-level keys of the context the model was given.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True when the reply hit the output token limit and was cut short.

refused.title: Refused
refused.description: True when local policy answered the question and NO AI provider was called at all.

refusal_category.title: Refusal Category
refusal_category.description: Which policy applied: secret_extraction, instruction_override, forecast_mutation, model_mutation.
